literal: Than the manliness of conducting oneself doing a woman's command, a modesty possessing woman indeed possesses greatness.
translation: A modest woman possesses far greater dignity than the manliness of a man who lives carrying out the commands of his wife.
modern: மனைவியின் ஏவல்களைச் செய்து வாழ்கின்ற ஆணின் ஆண்மையைக் காட்டிலும், நாணமுடைய பெண்ணே பெருமை உடையவள் ஆவாள்.
explanation: This couplet compares the submissive behavior of a man who obeys his wife's commands with the natural modesty of a woman. The author states that a woman who possesses a natural sense of shame or modesty (நாண்) is far more dignified and great than a man who loses his independence by acting according to a woman's dictates. The contrast is drawn between 'ஆண்மை' (manliness) which is compromised by subservience, and 'நாண்' (modesty) which elevates a woman's stature. Thus, true greatness lies in maintaining one's natural role and self-respect rather than yielding to improper dominance.
